description: A test script for verifying 'git stash' behavior with --include-untracked and related options, including various scenarios of stashing, popping, and showing stash contents involving untracked files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path is missing.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file is not empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.
